title: Owe taxes? Don't use a credit card (Short)

lines.say: First, file on time even if you can't pay. The late-filing penalty is usually about ten times the late-payment one.

lines.cap: Then compare. $2,400 on a credit card at $450 a month: about $215 in fees and interest.
lines.say: Then compare. Twenty-four hundred on a credit card at four fifty a month: about two fifteen in fees and interest.
An IRS short-term plan: about eighty-six.
